summary: The proposal introduces a unified API and execution protocol for user-defined functions (UDFs) that can run across multiple programming languages in Spark Connect, enabling external workers via inter-process communication (IPC). A user encountered an error when attempting to alter a VARCHAR column from length 10 to 25 in Spark SQL, receiving a NOT_SUPPORTED_CHANGE_COLUMN exception. The discussion centers on whether Spark should support type expansion for VARCHAR columns, with the user expressing willingness to work on a solution. Participants raised concerns about missing DSv2 interface details, test coverage, and potential support for executor-level caching and broader API use cases.
